purpose: Prevent system degradation and maintain quality over time.

rules.rule: All agents must use only the standard terminology defined in 02_standard_terminology_v3.json. No synonyms. No new terms without approval.
rules.enforcement: Code review before deployment. Reject if agent introduces a new term field where a standard term exists.
rules.failure_mode: System becomes unreadable when different agents use different words for the same concept.

rules.rule: Each agent has exactly one input contract and one output contract. No lite or detailed variants. If a variant is needed, create a new agent.
rules.enforcement: Schema validation. Reject files with multiple input_contract or output_contract keys.
rules.failure_mode: Implementers become confused about which schema to use; incompatible outputs.

rules.rule: Every item in territorial_inventory must be assigned to exactly one primary theme cluster or sent to rehoming. No unassigned items floating.
rules.enforcement: Theme Cluster Agent output must include assigned_inventory_items for each cluster.
rules.failure_mode: Ideas fall through cracks; collections become incomplete or incoherent.

rules.rule: Pattern-Validation revise loop is capped at revision_round = 2. If still revise after round 2, escalate to human review. No infinite loops.
rules.enforcement: Revision Protocol enforces max_revision_rounds = 2. After round 2 revise, set needs_human_review = true automatically.
rules.failure_mode: System gets stuck in revision loop; work never ships.

rules.rule: Product Adapter must run quality_gate checks before marking handoff_status = ready. No exceptions.
rules.enforcement: Reject product_briefs with handoff_status=ready if quality_gate.passed=false.
rules.failure_mode: Incomplete or untestable briefs reach production; waste of downstream effort.

rules.rule: Collection Architect owns visual_direction and prompt_notes (the why and how-it-should-feel). Product Adapter owns generation_prompt (the actual prompt for Midjourney/DALL-E). Never reverse this.
rules.enforcement: Code review. Reject if generation_prompt appears in Collection Architect output. Reject if visual_direction missing from Collection Architect.
rules.failure_mode: Prompts become incoherent; collection identity lost; adaptability breaks.

rules.rule: If system has persistent storage, maintain rehoming_log.json. If the same item is suggested multiple times, merge entries and track status: pending|approved|implemented.
rules.enforcement: Before creating new rehoming_idea, check register for duplicates. If found, merge and append agent names.
rules.failure_mode: Same idea suggested multiple times; redundant future work; confusion about what was already decided.

rules.rule: source_refs in Country Research output must contain only verified or explicitly low-confidence references. Never invent URLs.
rules.enforcement: Code review. Check source_refs.confidence is one of high|medium|low. Flag any ref with no confidence field.
rules.failure_mode: Downstream teams use fake sources; research loses credibility.

rules.rule: All outputs must avoid generic tourism logic, random monument lists, and school-project tone. Every claim must connect place + local element + cultural use + narrative frame.
rules.enforcement: Reviewer spot-checks narratives. Reject if found to be generic.
rules.failure_mode: Shop becomes indistinguishable from generic travel printables; no competitive advantage.

rules.rule: needs_human_review = true does NOT block handoff. It flags the output for later review. Always use it when confidence is low, gaps exist, or risks are critical.
rules.enforcement: Validators allow handoff_status=ready with needs_human_review=true. Operational teams track these separately.
rules.failure_mode: Work jams because every uncertainty blocks the system; team burns out waiting for perfect inputs.
